svg.text: Y-axis = log₁₀(validation score / 2000); ticks report mission days; shading marks trials worse than best-so-far.
Worker lanes use first-6-day hourly p75 bins; later gaps are interpolated/forward-filled. Validation only; statistics cover executed W00/W01 controls.
